scope: Controlled sampling experiment only, not application adoption.
setup: Analytic continuous RGB/mono scenes; exact known subpixel shifts, never reference interpolation to synthesize observations. Four seeds, mono and all four Bayer patterns, 128 fixed stack frames per case, noise sigma 4. Ungated radius 0.75 compared with ordinary bilinear radius 1. Gated controls use 64 separate training observations in two independent halves and include mixed textured/flat regions.
method: Use the same positive kernel for raw colour samples and their coverage. Narrow kernel is max(1-abs(dx)/0.75,0)*max(1-abs(dy)/0.75,0), normalized by 0.75 squared before blending with ordinary bilinear sampling. Shared colour gate: independent training averages are Gaussian 1.5 minus its Gaussian 8 background; local 33-pixel correlation above 0.8, with a Gaussian 3 transition. All stack frames retained; no output sharpening.

validation.flat_and_noise_only_gate: exactly zero in all evaluated controls, including flat regions of mixed scenes
validation.coverage: all evaluated channel samples have positive direct support

decision: Unconditional narrow sampling rejected because flat-noise RMS rises about 34%. The independent-structure gate preserves ordinary sampling in noise-only/flat controls and reduces textured/mixed RMSE about 19-35%; proceed to one fixed paired Jupiter pilot, without changing application defaults.
